input: Find a co-working space near my neighborhood

gold.taskTitle: Find a Co-Working Space Near My Neighborhood
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify a suitable co-working space close to the user's neighborhood based on their specific needs and preferences.

questions.title: What neighborhood or city are you currently based in?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to narrow down the search area.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel from home?
questions.description: Determine the acceptable distance or commute time to the co-working space.

questions.title: What is your budget per day, week, or month?
questions.description: Understand the user's spending limit to filter options by pricing tier.

questions.title: Will you need a private office or an open hot desk?
questions.description: Clarify the type of workspace setup the user requires for their work style.

questions.title: Which specific amenities matter most to you?
questions.description: Find out which features are non-negotiable, such as fast Wi-Fi, meeting rooms, printing, or a café.

questions.title: How many days per week do you plan to use it?
questions.description: Determine usage frequency to help decide between a day pass, part-time, or full-time membership.

questions.title: Do you need it available by a specific start date?
questions.description: Establish any time urgency or deadline that should shape how quickly the search needs to be completed.
